title: Blue-ringed Octopus Venom Fact
idea: A tiny blue-ringed octopus carries enough venom to kill over 20 adult humans within minutes, and no antivenom exists.

lines.text: Samundar ki yeh choti si makhluk pal bhar mein jaan le sakti hai!
Iske paas itna zeher hai ki 20 se zyada logon ki jaan le le.
Yeh khatarnak zeher sirf kuch hi minutes mein asar dikhata hai.
Hairani ki baat yeh hai ki iska koi antivenom hi nahi hai!
Kya aapko pata hai iske ring ka rang badalta hai?
Kya aap kabhi aise khatarnak samundari jeev ke saamne gaye ho?

youtube.title: Yeh Chhota Octopus Le Sakta Hai 20 Logon Ki Jaan! 🐙 #shorts
youtube.description:
Jaaniye blue-ringed octopus ke baare mein ek hairan karne wala sach. Iska ek katilana zeher aur bina antivenom wali kahani!

facts.claim: Carries enough venom to kill over 20 adult humans within minutes.
No blue-ringed octopus antivenom is available.
